criterion: Given the configured V4 launcher page is available, open it and verify that at least one module card is visible with an Open module control.
reason: The authenticated Metricell Launcher displayed 12 visible module cards, each with an Open control; the Agentic AI card and its Open control were directly visible.
steps_taken: Navigated to the required V4 launcher URL and completed the permitted email-and-Continue authentication sequence.
Returned to the launcher independently for this criterion and read the browser URL as https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher.
Inspected the launcher and confirmed visible module cards with Open controls.
Captured and verified separate non-empty initial and final PNG evidence.

criterion: On a visible module card, select the Open module control and verify that the selected module page is displayed.
reason: Selecting the visible Open Agentic AI control navigated from the launcher to https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/agentic-ai, where the Agentic AI interface was displayed.
steps_taken: Returned independently to the required launcher and read the browser URL as https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher.
Captured the criterion initial state and the launcher immediately before opening the module.
Selected the visible Open Agentic AI control.
Confirmed the browser navigated to /agentic-ai and displayed the Agentic AI interface with its agent selector, prompt control, conversation tab, and map.
Captured and verified separate non-empty after-open and final PNG evidence.

criterion: After the module opens, verify that the resulting module page displays without a load error and capture evidence of both the launcher card and the opened module page.
reason: The Agentic AI module page rendered at /agentic-ai with its primary controls, conversation workspace, and map visible. Playwright reported zero console errors after the module opened. Criterion-specific evidence includes both the launcher card and opened module page.
steps_taken: Returned independently to the required launcher and read the browser URL as https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/launcher.
Captured the criterion initial state and the launcher card immediately before opening Agentic AI.
Selected the visible Open Agentic AI control.
Confirmed the module page rendered at https://o2intelligence-v4-dev.metricell.com/agentic-ai with no visible load error and zero Playwright console errors.
Captured and verified separate non-empty after-open and final PNG evidence, then restored the application to the launcher.
